title: 4-Bit Ripple-Carry Adder
description: Synthesizable combinational 4-bit ripple-carry adder in IEEE VHDL-93 using concurrent XOR/AND/OR carry-chain equations and std_logic_vector ports.

title: Parameterized Synchronous Up/Down Counter
description: Generic-width synchronous binary up/down counter with active-high reset, count enable, direction control, and terminal-count flag in synthesizable VHDL.

title: Traffic Light Moore Finite State Machine
description: Two-process Moore finite state machine for a main-and-side-road traffic intersection controller with enumerated state types, vehicle sensor input, and glitch-free output decoding.

title: UART Serial Transmitter with Package Constants
description: Multi-file synthesizable 8N1 UART serial transmitter with baud-rate shift FSM, shared configuration package (uart_pkg.vhd), and structural verification testbench (tb_uart.vhd).

title: Pipelined 8-Bit ALU and Register File
description: Multi-file pipelined 8-bit processor datapath integrating a registered ALU top-level (alu_top.vhd), opcode package (alu_pkg.vhd), dual-port register file (regfile.vhd), and testbench (tb_alu.vhd).
